texts.NIV84: Does not wisdom call out? Does not understanding raise her voice?
texts.KJV: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
texts.NKJV:
Does not wisdom cry out,
And understanding lift up her voice?
texts.DRB: Doth not wisdom cry aloud, and prudence put forth her voice ?

texts.NIV84: On the heights along the way, where the paths meet, she takes her stand;
texts.KJV: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
texts.NKJV:
She takes her stand on the top of the high hill,
Beside the way, where the paths meet.
texts.DRB: Standing in the top of the highest places by the way, in the midst of the paths.

texts.NIV84: beside the gates leading into the city, at the entrances, she cries aloud:
texts.KJV: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.
texts.NKJV:
She cries out by the gates, at the entry of the city,
At the entrance of the doors:
texts.DRB: Beside the gates of the city, in the very doors she speaketh, saying:

texts.NIV84: "To you, O men, I call out; I raise my voice to all mankind.
texts.KJV: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.
texts.NKJV:
“To you, O men, I call,
And my voice is to the sons of men.
texts.DRB: O ye men, to you I call, and my voice is to the sons of men.

texts.NIV84: You who are simple, gain prudence; you who are foolish, gain understanding.
texts.KJV: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
texts.NKJV:
O you simple ones, understand prudence,
And you fools, be of an understanding heart.
texts.DRB: O little ones, understand subtilty, and ye unwise, take notice.

texts.NIV84: Listen, for I have worthy things to say; I open my lips to speak what is right.
texts.KJV: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.
texts.NKJV:
Listen, for I will speak of excellent things,
And from the opening of my lips will come right things;
texts.DRB: Hear, for I will speak of great things: and my lips shall be opened to preach right things.

texts.NIV84: My mouth speaks what is true, for my lips detest wickedness.
texts.KJV: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
texts.NKJV:
For my mouth will speak truth;
Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
texts.DRB: My mouth shall meditate truth, and my lips shall hate wickedness.

texts.NIV84: All the words of my mouth are just; none of them is crooked or perverse.
texts.KJV: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.
texts.NKJV:
All the words of my mouth are with righteousness;
Nothing crooked or perverse is in them.
texts.DRB: All my words are just, there is nothing wicked nor perverse in them.

texts.NIV84: To the discerning all of them are right; they are faultless to those who have knowledge.
texts.KJV: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.
texts.NKJV:
They are all plain to him who understands,
And right to those who find knowledge.
texts.DRB: They are right to them that understand, and just to them that find knowledge.

texts.NIV84: Choose my instruction instead of silver, knowledge rather than choice gold,
texts.KJV: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.
texts.NKJV:
Receive my instruction, and not silver,
And knowledge rather than choice gold;
texts.DRB: Receive my instruction, and not money: choose knowledge rather than gold.

texts.NIV84: for wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire can compare with her.
texts.KJV: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
texts.NKJV:
For wisdom is better than rubies,
And all the things one may desire cannot be compared with her.
texts.DRB: 11For wisdom is better than all the most precious things: and whatsoever may be desired cannot be compared to

texts.NIV84: "I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence; I possess knowledge and discretion.
texts.KJV: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.
texts.NKJV:
“I, wisdom, dwell with prudence,
And find out knowledge and discretion.
texts.DRB: I wisdom dwell in counsel, and am present in learned thoughts.

texts.NIV84: To fear the LORD is to hate evil; I hate pride and arrogance, evil behavior and perverse speech.
texts.KJV: The fear of the Lord is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.
texts.DRB: The fear of the Lord hateth evil: I hate arrogance, and pride, and every wicked way, and a mouth with a double tongue.

texts.NIV84: Counsel and sound judgment are mine; I have understanding and power.
texts.KJV: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.
texts.NKJV:
Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom;
I am understanding, I have strength.
texts.DRB: Counsel and equity is mine, prudence is mine, strength is mine.

texts.NIV84: By me kings reign and rulers make laws that are just;
texts.KJV: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
texts.NKJV:
By me kings reign,
And rulers decree justice.
texts.DRB: By me kings reign, and lawgivers decree just things,

texts.NIV84: by me princes govern, and all nobles who rule on earth.
texts.KJV: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
texts.NKJV:
By me princes rule, and nobles,
All the judges of the earth.
texts.DRB: By me princes rule, and the mighty decree justice.

texts.NIV84: I love those who love me, and those who seek me find me.
texts.KJV: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
texts.NKJV:
I love those who love me,
And those who seek me diligently will find me.
texts.DRB: I love them that love me: and they that in the morning early watch for me, shall find me.

texts.NIV84: With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and prosperity.
texts.KJV: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.
texts.NKJV:
Riches and honor are with me,
Enduring riches and righteousness.
texts.DRB: With me are riches and glory, glorious riches and justice.

texts.NIV84: My fruit is better than fine gold; what I yield surpasses choice silver.
texts.KJV: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.
texts.NKJV:
My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold,
And my revenue than choice silver.
texts.DRB: For my fruit is better than gold and the precious stone, and my blossoms than choice silver.

texts.NIV84: I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice,
texts.KJV: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:
texts.NKJV:
I traverse the way of righteousness,
In the midst of the paths of justice,
texts.DRB: I walk in the way of justice, in the midst of the paths of judgment,

texts.NIV84: bestowing wealth on those who love me and making their treasuries full.
texts.KJV: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.
texts.NKJV:
That I may cause those who love me to inherit wealth,
That I may fill their treasuries.
texts.DRB: That I may enrich them that love me, and may fill their treasures.

texts.NIV84: "The LORD brought me forth as the first of his works,, before his deeds of old;
texts.KJV: The Lord possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.
texts.NKJV:
“The Lord possessed me at the beginning of His way,
Before His works of old.
texts.DRB: The Lord possessed me in the beginning of his ways, before he made any thing from the beginning.

texts.NIV84: I was appointed from eternity, from the beginning, before the world began.
texts.KJV: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.
texts.NKJV:
I have been established from everlasting,
From the beginning, before there was ever an earth.
texts.DRB: I was set up from eternity, and of old before the earth was made.

texts.NIV84: When there were no oceans, I was given birth, when there were no springs abounding with water;
texts.KJV: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.
texts.NKJV:
When there were no depths I was brought forth,
When there were no fountains abounding with water.
texts.DRB: The depths were not as yet, and I was already conceived. neither had the fountains of waters as yet sprung out:

texts.NIV84: before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was given birth,
texts.KJV: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:
texts.NKJV:
Before the mountains were settled,
Before the hills, I was brought forth;
texts.DRB: The mountains with their huge bulk had not as yet been established: before the hills I was brought forth:

texts.NIV84: before he made the earth or its fields or any of the dust of the world.
texts.KJV: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.
texts.NKJV:
While as yet He had not made the earth or the fields,
Or the primal dust of the world.
texts.DRB: He had not yet made the earth, nor the rivers, nor the poles of the world.

texts.NIV84: I was there when he set the heavens in place, when he marked out the horizon on the face of the deep,
texts.KJV: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:
texts.NKJV:
When He prepared the heavens, I was there,
When He drew a circle on the face of the deep,
texts.DRB: When he prepared the heavens, I was present: when with a certain law and compass he enclosed the depths:

texts.NIV84: when he established the clouds above and fixed securely the fountains of the deep,
texts.KJV: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
texts.NKJV:
When He established the clouds above,
When He strengthened the fountains of the deep,
texts.DRB: When he established the sky above, and poised the fountains of waters:

texts.NIV84: when he gave the sea its boundary so the waters would not overstep his command, and when he marked out the foundations of the earth.
texts.KJV: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:
texts.NKJV:
When He assigned to the sea its limit,
So that the waters would not transgress His command,
When He marked out the foundations of the earth,
texts.DRB: When he compassed the sea with its bounds, and set a law to the waters that they should not pass their limits: when be balanced the foundations of the earth;

texts.NIV84: Then I was the craftsman at his side. I was filled with delight day after day, rejoicing always in his presence,
texts.KJV: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;
texts.DRB: I was with him forming all things: and was delighted every day, playing before him at all times;

texts.NIV84: rejoicing in his whole world and delighting in mankind.
texts.KJV: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.
texts.NKJV:
Rejoicing in His inhabited world,
And my delight was with the sons of men.
texts.DRB: Playing in the world: and my delights were to be with the children of men.

blocks.title: Blessed is He Who Listens to Wisdom

texts.NIV84: "Now then, my sons, listen to me; blessed are those who keep my ways.
texts.KJV: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.
texts.NKJV:
“Now therefore, listen to me, my children,
For blessed are those who keep my ways.
texts.DRB: Now therefore, ye children, hear me: Blessed are they that keep my ways.

texts.NIV84: Listen to my instruction and be wise; do not ignore it.
texts.KJV: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
texts.NKJV:
Hear instruction and be wise,
And do not disdain it.
texts.DRB: Hear instruction and be wise, and refuse it not.

texts.NIV84: Blessed is the man who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at my doorway.
texts.KJV: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
texts.NKJV:
Blessed is the man who listens to me,
Watching daily at my gates,
Waiting at the posts of my doors.
texts.DRB: Blessed is the man that heareth me, and that watcheth daily at my gates, and waiteth at the posts of my doors.

texts.NIV84: For whoever finds me finds life and receives favor from the LORD.
texts.KJV: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the Lord.
texts.NKJV:
For whoever finds me finds life,
And obtains favor from the Lord;
texts.DRB: He that shall find me, shall find life, and shall have salvation from the Lord:

texts.NIV84: But whoever fails to find me harms himself; all who hate me love death."
texts.KJV: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
texts.NKJV:
But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul;
All those who hate me love death.”
texts.DRB: But he that shall sin against me, shall hurt his own soul. All that hate me love death.
